services.desc: Your safety in the air is the primary concern at Rocket City Helicopters. Count on our more than 30 years of experience to make sure your aircraft is maintained properly. As North Alabama's only certified, factory-authorized service center for Robinson Helicopter, we have the personnel and tools to perform warranty work and all required inspections and services. We provide FAA-approved and factory-provided parts and can offer reduced overhead in operations and maintenance. If you fly another type of helicopter, no problem.
